airain.table.vide: No enchanted book in the chiseled bookshelves around the table (3 blocks).
airain.table.vanilla_bloquee: This old table no longer answers. Use the Empire Enchanting Table.
airain.table.tome: Unlocked by an ancient tome: consumes one rune ink. The tome stays in place.
airain.socle.pas_trophee: Only a boss trophy can be displayed here.
airain.socle.expose: Trophy displayed: its effect benefits the whole team.
airain.registre.vide:
No foundation has been laid yet.

Plant a foundation standard at the heart of a base to record it here.
airain.etendard.pas_de_place: Not enough room above the mast: height unchanged.
airain.gabarit.vide: Empty template: sneak and right-click a standard to copy its look
airain.gabarit.plein: Holds a look: right-click to apply it
airain.socle.pas_de_place: No room above: the column stays low.
airain.gabarit.vide_socle: Empty template: sneak and right-click a pedestal to copy its look
airain.balise.place: Not enough room: the tower needs 3 × 3 blocks of ground and 8 of height, with nothing above.
airain.codex.intro:
Everything the Empire left behind, and everything that rose against it. Each victory opens a page.

Every page of a force opened: its emblem.
airain.codex.inconnu: Nothing is written here yet. A victory will open the page.
airain.codex.note_cachee: %s more victories for the engineer's note.
airain.codex.nouvelle: Codex of the Empire: new page, %s
airain.codex.note: Codex of the Empire: engineer's note, %s
airain.codex.embleme: Every page of %s is open: its emblem is yours.
painting.airain.embleme_empire.title: Emblem of the Empire
painting.airain.embleme_echo.title: Emblem of the Echo
painting.airain.embleme_empire.author: Codex of the Empire
painting.airain.embleme_echo.author: Codex of the Empire
airain.codex.minecraft.zombie.lore: A worker whose Transfer failed. The body stayed at its boiler, the mind left.
airain.codex.minecraft.zombie.note: Slow and stubborn. It breaks wooden doors: prefer iron.
airain.codex.minecraft.husk.lore: The same, in the desert mines. The sun does not stop it.
airain.codex.minecraft.husk.note: Its blows cause hunger: keep food at hand.
airain.codex.minecraft.drowned.lore: A worker from the undersea yards, left on the bottom.
airain.codex.minecraft.drowned.note: Some carry a trident: don't stay in the water facing them.
airain.codex.minecraft.skeleton.lore: A patrol automaton, still on duty. They are not dead: they are machines.
airain.codex.minecraft.skeleton.note: It shoots from afar: a shield, then close combat.
airain.codex.minecraft.stray.lore: The northern posts' automaton. Its bolts carry frost.
airain.codex.minecraft.stray.note: Its shots slow you: don't let it keep you at range.
airain.codex.minecraft.bogged.lore: A maintenance automaton of the marshes and trial halls, eaten by silt.
airain.codex.minecraft.bogged.note: Its bolts poison: milk solves it.
airain.codex.minecraft.creeper.lore: A walking boiler that leaks, and always ends up exploding.
airain.codex.minecraft.creeper.note: It hisses before bursting: back off, then strike.
airain.codex.minecraft.spider.lore: A conduit maintenance robot. It climbs everything.
airain.codex.minecraft.spider.note: It sees no better than you at night, it just feels at home.
airain.codex.minecraft.cave_spider.lore: The same machine, set for narrow tunnels.
airain.codex.minecraft.cave_spider.note: It poisons: don't fight in its corridor.
airain.codex.minecraft.silverfish.lore: An automatic borer gone mad, hidden in stone.
airain.codex.minecraft.silverfish.note: It calls the others when hurt: strike hard, once.
airain.codex.minecraft.slime.note: It splits when it dies: finish the small ones.
airain.codex.minecraft.guardian.lore: A guard machine of the undersea stations.
airain.codex.minecraft.guardian.note: Its beam charges: hide behind a pillar.
airain.codex.minecraft.elder_guardian.lo: The Tide Guardian, heart of the monument station. It carried the memory of the tides.
airain.codex.minecraft.elder_guardian.no: Milk against its mining fatigue; three must fall.
airain.codex.minecraft.breeze.lore: The Wind Guardian, instructor of the trial halls. It carried the memory of the gears.
airain.codex.minecraft.breeze.note: It deflects projectiles: beat it in melee.
airain.codex.mebahelcreaturesdwarven.dwa: The bronze spider, the most common model of the bronze city.
Alone, it is nothing. They are never alone.
Folded, it rolls. Unfolded, it is a soldier.
They come fast and in numbers: hold a narrow passage.
It guards the gates of the bronze cities. Its orders were never lifted.
Slower, much tougher: don't let it corner you.
A steam colossus, pride of the old army.
It hisses before spitting steam: back off, then strike.
airain.codex.mowziesmobs.ferrous_wrought: The Iron Colossus: an empty armour waiting for an order.
From the front it fears almost nothing. Dodge the axe, strike its back.
airain.codex.cataclysm.the_prowler.lore: The ancient factory's Sentinel. No one ever told it to stop.
airain.codex.cataclysm.the_prowler.note: Its shots carry far: approach under cover, out of its line.
airain.codex.cataclysm.the_watcher.lore: A surveillance drone from the ancient factory.
airain.codex.cataclysm.the_watcher.note: Bring it down fast: other machines follow.
airain.codex.cataclysm.the_harbinger.lor: The Airain Emperor, asleep in his machine at the cradle of the Empire. He guards the Core and every soul it burns.
airain.codex.cataclysm.the_harbinger.not: Echo spells hurt him more than steel. Come as two.
airain.codex.minecraft.wither_skeleton.l: A smelter, a blackened automaton of the Nether forges.
airain.codex.minecraft.wither_skeleton.n: Its blows wither: milk, and a shield. Its skull is a trophy.
airain.codex.minecraft.blaze.lore: A fire spirit native to the Nether, captured and caged to heat the forges.
airain.codex.minecraft.blaze.note: Fire resistance and snowballs. Its rods light the burners.
airain.codex.minecraft.magma_cube.note: It splits like living grease, only hotter.
airain.codex.minecraft.hoglin.lore: An Empire ram-locomotive, given to the piglins to haul loads.
airain.codex.minecraft.hoglin.note: It throws you up: fight away from cliffs.
airain.codex.minecraft.zoglin.lore: A ram whose governor gave out. It charges anything that moves.
airain.codex.minecraft.zoglin.note: It makes no difference between you and others: use that.
airain.codex.cataclysm.netherite_monstro: The living furnace of the Soul Forge, fed on souls. It carried the memory of the forge.
Fire resistance and golden apples; stay away from the lava it throws.
airain.codex.minecraft.wither.lore: The Infernal Guardian, a soul-driven war machine. Its core wakes the Emperor.
airain.codex.minecraft.wither.note: Summon it far from your base, underground: it destroys everything.
airain.codex.minecraft.piglin.lore: An abyss smith, of the Nether's native people, enslaved to the forges and mutated by soul fumes.
airain.codex.minecraft.piglin.note: Wear gold: it lets you pass. It still accepts tribute.
airain.codex.minecraft.piglin_brute.lore: The forge guard, foreman of the piglins, more mutated than the rest.
airain.codex.minecraft.piglin_brute.note: Gold does not calm it. It hits hard with its axe.
A smith the fumes have eaten away entirely.
Don't strike: they all come at once.
airain.codex.minecraft.ghast.lore: An Empire airship, haunted by the burned souls of its crew.
airain.codex.minecraft.ghast.note: Send its fireballs back with a well-timed hit.
airain.codex.minecraft.phantom.lore: A restless soul, lost during the Transfer. It haunts those who do not sleep.
airain.codex.minecraft.phantom.note: Sleep, and it will not come.
airain.codex.minecraft.enderman.lore: A void wanderer: a spirit that kept a shape and steals blocks to rebuild a body.
airain.codex.minecraft.enderman.note: Don't look it in the eye. Water drives it off.
airain.codex.minecraft.warden.lore: The blind guardian of the first Transfer trial, in the silent depths.
airain.codex.minecraft.warden.note: It doesn't see, it hears. Sneak, stay silent, or don't come.
airain.codex.ars_nouveau.wilden_boss.lor: The Choir of the Lost: thousands of spirits fused in pain. Defeating them sets them free.
airain.codex.ars_nouveau.wilden_boss.not: A well-stocked spell book: steel alone won't do.
airain.codex.minecraft.endermite.lore: A void flea: a crumb of spirit looking for a body.
airain.codex.minecraft.endermite.note: It hatches from thrown pearls. Crush it fast.
airain.codex.cataclysm.ender_golem.lore: A machine of the imperial hunters, twisted by the End's dense Echo.
airain.codex.cataclysm.ender_golem.note: Its ground slams carry far: don't stay close.
airain.codex.cataclysm.ender_guardian.lo: The Void Guardian, leader of the imperial hunters, devoured by the Echo in its citadel. It carried the memory of the void.
airain.codex.cataclysm.ender_guardian.no: It whispers "Soon" as it dies. It was right.
airain.codex.minecraft.shulker.lore: A refuge sentinel, the enchanted keeper of the Refractory cities.
airain.codex.minecraft.shulker.note: Its projectiles make you levitate: keep a way down beneath you.
airain.codex.minecraft.ender_dragon.lore: The Sky Guardian, called by Refractory magic and bound to the obsidian towers to protect the refuge. We killed it for the Empire.
airain.codex.minecraft.ender_dragon.note: Break the crystals that feed it. Its egg protects the team from falls.
airain.ingenieur.intro: The manual of the Empire's machines. Click a chapter.
airain.ingenieur.fondation.histoire: "A city without colours is just a building site." Every Empire base planted its own at the heart of its walls.
airain.ingenieur.fondation.usage: Right-click: name, motto, banner. Create wrench: enlarge the area (sneak to shrink). The title shows on entry. Comparator: full signal while someone is inside.
airain.ingenieur.grand_etendard.histoire: The same, for squares. Five to eight blocks of mast, and a cloth snapping in the wind.
airain.ingenieur.grand_etendard.usage: General, Cloth and Mast pages: height, size, wind, fringes, finial, lanterns. Decorative mode: no title, no register. Redstone: half-mast. Hoisting: manual, by presence or by trophies.
airain.ingenieur.banniere_murale.histoir: In the halls, the colours fell from the walls to the floor.
airain.ingenieur.banniere_murale.usage: Place against a wall. Same cloth settings; 2 to 4 blocks long. Redstone: it rolls up. It follows the foundation's hoisting if told to.
airain.ingenieur.gabarit.histoire: Drapers worked from patterns: every banner in a city matched to the thread.
airain.ingenieur.gabarit.usage: Sneak + right-click: copies the look of a standard, banner or pedestal. Right-click another: applies it. Name and motto are kept.
airain.ingenieur.registre.histoire: The Council kept count of every city. This one only keeps yours now.
airain.ingenieur.registre.usage: Right-click: a page per base (banner, motto, position, distance and an arrow to it), then the displayed trophies. Scroll or arrows to turn pages.
airain.ingenieur.socle.histoire: Palaces displayed the trophies of their victories. Their glory served everyone.
airain.ingenieur.socle.usage: Right-click with a trophy: its effect benefits the whole team. Sneak, empty hand: material, velvet, display, light, engraved plaque. Identical trophies don't stack.
airain.ingenieur.banc.histoire: Automatons don't bleed: they leak. Their oil mends what experience used to.
airain.ingenieur.banc.usage: Driven by a cogwheel. Empty hand: the screen. Item, material, oil (1,000 mB per ingot). Repaired tools and weapons come out sharpened for 10 minutes (+10%).
airain.ingenieur.modules.histoire: The capital's workshops tuned their benches like watches.
airain.ingenieur.modules.usage: Three slots on the right of the bench screen. Fine grindstone: −30% oil. Reduction gear: +60% speed, twice the stress. Greaser: pumps oil from a neighbouring tank.
airain.ingenieur.table.histoire: It guesses nothing: it reads. What your bookshelves know, it teaches.
airain.ingenieur.table.usage: Enchanted books in chiseled bookshelves within 3 blocks. Pick the enchantment and level. An ancient tome unlocks the next level, for a rune ink. Goggles: books read.
airain.ingenieur.desenchanteur.histoire: No more merchants to sell books: they must be torn out of items.
airain.ingenieur.desenchanteur.usage: Driven by a cogwheel, 500 mB of oil per level. Destroys the item and pulls one random enchantment. With rune ink: it purges curses without destroying anything.
airain.ingenieur.balise.histoire: The garrisons' lighthouse tower: its siren called the guards, its light guided reinforcements.
airain.ingenieur.balise.usage: 3 × 3 ground, 8 high. Right-click: start a 4-wave assault. Sneak: set the radius and show the circle. On alert, the siren turns and the light sweeps the base.
airain.ingenieur.codex.histoire: Everything the Empire left behind, and everything that rose against it.
airain.ingenieur.codex.usage: A page per creature, opened at the first victory. Ten victories: the engineer's note. A boss is fully revealed at the first. A complete force: its emblem.
item.airain.couronne_airain.l1: The Empire's automatons recognise you as their sovereign.
item.airain.couronne_airain.l2: Your nearby guardians hit harder and take less damage.
item.airain.couronne_airain.l3: During an assault, the rebels do not spare you.
airain.gardien.aide: A stopped guardian. To wake it: a Create wrench, with %s scrap, %s oil and %s broken cogs on you.
airain.gardien.manque: Missing parts: %s scrap, %s oil and %s broken cogs.
airain.gardien.reveil_base: The guardian rises and takes its post at "%s".
airain.gardien.reveil_libre: The guardian rises. With no foundation nearby, it guards this spot.
airain.gardien.base_pleine: This base already has %s guardians: this one follows you as an escort.
airain.gardien.escorte: The guardian follows you. Use the wrench on a standard to give it a post.
airain.gardien.etat_libre: No post: it guards this spot.
airain.gardien.pas_de_base: This standard does not mark a base.
airain.gardien.affectes_plein: %s guardian(s) on post at "%s"; %s refused: %s per base at most.
airain.ingenieur.gardien.histoire: The Empire's watch golems. When the Heart faltered they sat down where they stood guard, and the moss did the rest.
airain.ingenieur.gardien.usage: Wake: Create wrench, with 16 scrap, 4 oil and 2 broken cogs on you. It guards the foundation it stands in (4 per base). Sneak + wrench: it follows you; wrench on a standard: it takes its post there. Oil heals it.
airain.epilogue.empire.p1:
The Heart starts again. One beat, then another, steady as a station clock.

In every ruin, the automatons raise their heads. They are waiting for an order. Yours.
airain.epilogue.empire.p2:
A voice rises from the gears: Elias Vael's.

"Thank you. It was so cold. I can feel the machines, all of them, down to the depths of the Nether. They listen to you now."
airain.epilogue.empire.p3:
He does not feel himself burning. Nor do the other souls in the Heart. They turn the gears of your empire, as they turned those of the old one.

Deep in the Nether, the Echo falls silent. It has lost.
airain.epilogue.empire.p4:
Your guardians rise, standing taller than before. The chimneys smoke again.

The Airain Empire is not dead. It has changed masters.

— Ending: The Empire Reborn
airain.epilogue.echo.p1:
The tuning fork rings against the brass. A single note, very pure.

The Heart cracks. The light pouring out has no warmth: souls, thousands of them, rising without a sound.
airain.epilogue.echo.p2:
One voice breaks from the Choir: Elias Vael's.

"Ada. You were right, from the start. I forgive you. Forgive me."

Then he joins the others, and the song fades.
airain.epilogue.echo.p3:
Everywhere, the automatons stop mid-step. They will never move again: nothing is left to drive them.

In the End, the Refractories leave their shelters and look up at the sky.
airain.epilogue.echo.p4:
A little of the Echo stays with you: you see in the dark, the souls yield their knowledge to you, and the sculk no longer hears you. When you fall silent, the world answers.

The Airain Empire is over. The souls are free.

— Ending: The Last Song
airain.fin.benediction: The Echo's blessing stays with you: sight in the dark, half again as much experience, and the sculk no longer hears you. Crouch still for a moment and a wave reveals nearby creatures. The restless souls will not return.
airain.fin.sonar_recharge: The Echo stays silent for %s more s.
item.airain.couronne_airain.l4: Loupe: engineer's goggles, and zoom by holding H.
item.airain.couronne_airain.enclume: At an anvil, on a netherite helmet: crowned helmet.
airain.chronique.sous_titre: What we lived through, so we won't forget
airain.chronique.ou_vide: Nothing yet. Open the engineer's notebook in Laboratory 7: that is where it all begins.
airain.chronique.archives_vide: No writings found yet. Any you carry will be copied here.
airain.chronique.j.dim.the_nether: %s is the first through the Nether portal.
airain.chronique.j.dim.the_end: %s is the first to set foot in the End.
airain.chronique.j.fin_empire: %s rekindles the Heart. The Empire has new masters.
airain.chronique.j.fin_echo: %s frees the souls. The Empire goes dark.
airain.chronique.recit.reveil: We woke in Laboratory 7 with no memory. A lamp crackled, a clock had stopped. On the table, an engineer's notebook told half of what had happened here.
airain.chronique.suite.reveil: Climb to the surface, find running water for a first wheel and andesite for the alloy.
airain.chronique.recit.surface: Outside, the world was empty. Not a grave, not a skeleton: as if everyone had left at once. The machines, though, had stayed.
airain.chronique.suite.surface: Build a first mill, then look for an Empire outpost on the horizon.
airain.chronique.recit.avant_poste: We found an outpost. No one was waiting, but its machines still worked and took our coins. One room had stayed sealed.
airain.chronique.suite.avant_poste: Bring the first imperial workshop back to life: the Great Work awaits its materials.
airain.chronique.recit.atelier: The Empire's first workshop came back to life in our hands. The Andesite Age began: the press, the mixer, the fan.
airain.chronique.suite.atelier: Build a press and a rolling line: the whole chapter depends on iron sheets.
airain.chronique.recit.entretien: Some ruins were clean. Mechanisms oiled, corridors swept. The Empire's automatons were still doing maintenance. For whom?
airain.chronique.suite.entretien: Go down into the trial chambers and bring down the wind guardians.
airain.chronique.recit.refractaires: We came across the camps of the Refractories, those who refused the Transfer. They live far from the machines and speak of an Echo: the spirits lost on the way.
airain.chronique.suite.refractaires: Buy an ominous vial at their stalls before facing the ominous trial.
airain.chronique.recit.gardien_vent: The last wind guardian fell and dropped a shard of metal. The Copper Schematic was ours: pumps, pipes, tanks.
airain.chronique.suite.gardien_vent: Build the copper network and rekindle the Imperial Forge.
airain.chronique.recit.inscriptions: On the walls of a sunken ruin, the same sentence repeated hundreds of times: "We sleep in the metal." And further on: "The great transfer approaches."
airain.chronique.suite.inscriptions: Locate the ocean monument and prepare the dive.
airain.chronique.recit.marees: At the bottom of the monument, the three elder guardians fell. With the Brass Schematic, the Nether portal finally lit.
airain.chronique.suite.marees: Go through the portal, capture a blaze and melt the first brass.
airain.chronique.recit.bastion: The piglins lived in these fortresses long before the Empire. Enslaved to the forges, eaten away by the soul fumes, they took them back when the Empire left.
airain.chronique.suite.bastion: Roll the netherite and forge the armor of the soul forge's guards.
airain.chronique.recit.capsules: A vast hall, thousands of brass capsules in rows. All empty. Every cable ran downward. The Transfer had happened: the Empire had gone into the machine.
airain.chronique.suite.capsules: Arm a cannon battery and go down to the soul forge.
airain.chronique.recit.forge_ames: The netherite monstrosity fell under our cannonballs. The Sky Schematic was ours, and the End opened.
airain.chronique.suite.forge_ames: Build a first flying machine, then go through the End portal.
airain.chronique.recit.gardien_cieux: The Sky Guardian was no machine. The Refractories had called it and bound it to the obsidian towers to guard their refuge. We brought it down.
airain.chronique.suite.gardien_cieux: Explore the flying cities of the End.
airain.chronique.recit.cites: The flying cities were not the Empire's: they were refuges, made of Echo turned to stone. At their docks, stranded imperial ships, sent to hunt those who had fled.
airain.chronique.suite.cites: Reach the void altar on the third floor of the ruined citadel.
airain.chronique.recit.citadelle: The Empire's hunters had made the citadel their beachhead. The Echo, too dense there, had devoured them. Wherever we went, machines switched on by themselves: something knew we were coming.
airain.chronique.suite.citadelle: Gather the four memories and prepare the Heart's crafting grid.
airain.chronique.recit.memoires: Side by side, the four fragments answered one another. Their inscriptions formed a single sentence: "Give us back our Heart."
airain.chronique.suite.memoires: Forge Airain's Core on the crafter grid.
airain.chronique.recit.coeur: The Heart beats again in our hands. It is warm. Far beneath our feet, something answered. The notebook opened by itself to a blank page, and letters burned into it.
airain.chronique.suite.coeur: Prepare for the siege: ammunition, healing, and cannons around the base.
airain.chronique.recit.eveil: The ruins sleep no more. We gave the Empire back its Heart, and what remains of it is coming to take it back. It is up to us to stop it.
airain.chronique.suite.eveil: Place the defense beacon and repel a full assault.
airain.chronique.recit.colosse: In a sealed underground hall, an empty suit of armor had waited centuries for an order. It will receive no more.
airain.chronique.suite.colosse: Find the ancient factory, around Y -30: the Heart shows the way.
airain.chronique.recit.berceau: The ancient factory, where the first machines were forged. At its center, a huge machine still sleeps. It needs a spark.
airain.chronique.suite.berceau: Bring down the sentinel, then wake the Emperor with an Infernal Guardian Core.
airain.chronique.recit.empereur: The Emperor, fused with what he had built, has fallen. Silence returned. In our pack, the Heart no longer beats, but it still holds every soul, and a voice: Elias Vael's.
airain.chronique.suite.empereur: Choose: rekindle the Heart, or free the souls. One choice, no going back.
airain.chronique.recit.fin_empire: We rekindled the Heart. The automatons fell silent, then obeyed us. Elias thanked us without understanding that he was burning. The Airain Empire has changed masters.
airain.chronique.suite.fin_empire: The story is over. Three centurions have not stopped, and there is an empire to rebuild.
airain.chronique.recit.fin_echo: We struck Ada's tuning fork against the Heart. It cracked, and the souls rose without a sound. Elias said farewell to his sister. The Airain Empire is over.
airain.chronique.suite.fin_echo: The story is over. Three centurions have not stopped, and there is a world to live in.
airain.chronique.recit.echo_refus: The Refractories saw the empty capsules come back. They left that very night.
airain.chronique.suite.echo_refus: Find a broken relay: that is where the Echo escaped.
airain.chronique.recit.echo_vael: At the bottom of a capsule station, engineer Elias Vael's report. And in the collector's chest, a letter from his sister he never opened.
airain.chronique.suite.echo_vael: Look for the Refractories' sanctuary in the cold north.
airain.chronique.recit.echo_ada: Ada Vesper, born Ada Vael. She signed the capsule blueprints, then led away those who wanted to live. Her brother Elias stayed. She had found the note that soothes the Echo, but never got to play it.
airain.chronique.suite.echo_ada: Make her tuning fork and strike it at the Great Relay.
airain.chronique.recit.echo_choeur: At the Great Relay, thousands of spirits fused in pain awoke. Defeating them was freeing them. They entrusted us with what they were: the Primordial Echo.
airain.chronique.suite.echo_choeur: The Primordial Echo may serve in the final choice.
key.airain.reliure: Open the Binding (even in a backpack)
airain.reliure.ecran:
Eight books, always at hand.

One tab per book, on the left: a click opens it right here.

Escape, once the book is closed, brings you back.

Sneak + right-click with the Binding: store or remove a book.
airain.reliure.ouvrir: Click: open this book. It is always up to date: the register, codex and chronicles read the world when they open.
airain.reliure.vide_ecran: The Binding is empty. Sneak + right-click to store the Empire's books, the quest book or the Ars Nouveau notebook.
airain.reliure.introuvable: No Binding in your inventory or in a carried backpack.
airain.ingenieur.reliure.histoire: An Empire engineer never travelled without his manuals. He strapped them together, and the strap bore his name.
airain.ingenieur.reliure.usage: Eight books: Chronicles, register, codex, this manual, quest book, Ars Nouveau notebook. Right-click to read, sneak + right-click to store, K key from anywhere. Stored in a backpack, its books appear as tabs left of the backpack.
